intent.summary: Displays and changes a persistent binary or mixed state.
useWhen: The choice takes effect as a durable on/off state
avoidWhen: The user is invoking a one-time action

semantics.childPolicy: one label subtree associated with the state
semantics.sizing: minimum interactive target plus label and state indicator
semantics.ordering: label and indicator order follows locale and presentation policy

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible or explicitly associated state description.

attributes.name: enabled
attributes.description: Whether user state changes are accepted.

constraints.expression: label has a non-empty accessible name
constraints.message: Every toggle requires a state description.

accessibility.role: switch or checkbox according to interaction convention
accessibility.focusBehavior: focusable when enabled and operable by primary activation keys
notes: Expose checked, unchecked, or mixed state.

mappings.strategy: Capture binding, label, state domain, and enabled state independently of style.
Select representation from interaction convention and stateModel.
Map through Qt Quick or Qt Widgets constructs using the same layout intent and accessibility contract.
caveats: Qt Quick and Qt Widgets differ in sizing, ownership, and event wiring.
